title: Align zero-slot dashboard with V2.1 capacity fallback
objective: Fix the generated zero-ready-slot message so it cannot tell workers to idle before they run the V2.1 fallback chain. Add a regression test for the exact mass-stop failure mode identified by PR #269 review.
acceptance: zero-ready-slot dashboard never recommends idle as the first action
message directs workers through review/recovery/backfill/mining fallback
regression test covers the zero-slot wording
